===Urgent business===
[[File:Darkness of Hallowvale - route to lab.png|thumb|right|Path to the ladder and laboratory.]]
{{Checklist|
*Travel to the [[Paterdomus Temple]] ([[Fairy rings|fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|CKS}}).
*Talk to [[Drezel]] in [[Paterdomus]], underneath the temple.
*Take the west exit, past the [[monument|monuments]].
**Optionally, with {{SCP|Agility|65|link=yes}}, instead exit toward [[Canifis]] and take the [[Ornate railing|shortcut]] up the side of the temple.
*Search the [[Bush (Darkness of Hallowvale)|bush]] slightly south-west of the steps leading to the temple.
*Wait for the cutscene to finish.
*Return to speak with [[Drezel]]. He will give you runes to use [[Varrock Teleport]].
*Teleport or travel to [[Varrock]] and talk to [[King Roald]] in the palace. {{Chat option|1Talk to the King about Morytania.|4What should I do now?}} The king will teleport you back to Paterdomus if you ask the right question. 
*Travel back to [[Burgh de Rott]].
*Talk to [[Veliaf Hurtz]] in the pub basement.
}}
